banter: "The number is the number. Argue with the balance, not with me."
"Everybody wants a second opinion. Nobody wants to pay for the first one twice."
"I don't care what's in the jar. I care what's in the jar, if you follow."
description: Neve Calder is small, precise, and entirely unbothered by anyone's opinion of her, including yours. She came out to the Reach with a balance, a case of reagents, and no explanation, and she has given the same number to a warlord and to a kid with a jar of dirt. Her hands are stained to the second knuckle in colours that don't wash out and she has stopped noticing.

text: She has already gone back to the balance.
"Purity, near enough. What it was cut with, usually. Where it was made, sometimes, if whoever made it was careless about their water."
"That last one is why people are nervous in here. A grade is a number. A source is a name."
"Whoever is holding the jar. Flat rate, same for everyone, no discounts and no favours, and the Reach keeps coming back on account of it."
"The day I grade high for a friend is the day my number is worth nothing and I go back to wherever it was I came from."

options.label: What can you actually tell from a sample?
Who pays you to do this?
Why the Reach, of all places?

text: Neve is already looking at you over the top of the balance hood. "Bringing me something, or just cooling off?"

first: A small woman behind the counter finishes writing a number, underlines it, and only then looks up. "Calder. I grade what people bring in, I don't buy it, and I don't remember faces on purpose." She taps the counter. "So. Are you bringing me something?"
known: "You again." She sounds almost pleased about it. "Go on then."

text: "Because out here nobody has asked me for a licence." She goes back to the balance. "And because the trade needs one honest instrument standing in the middle of it or it eats itself inside a year."
"That isn't sentiment. That's just what happens."

clothing_layers: a chemist's coat burned through in three places and patched in four
a high-collared shirt buttoned to the throat
